ibm-vga.identityEvidence: Pictured variant: IBM PS/2 Display Adapter 75X9017, IBM 72X8287 VGA, 256 KB DRAM, 8-bit ISA. UMMR photographs its owned IBM PS/2 Display Adapter 75X9017 and states that its VGA chip is the same as PS/2 Models 50/60/80. Photograph visibly shows 75X9017 and IBM 72X8287. IBM Hardware Interface Technical Reference, VGA Function, October 1990, printed page 21 (PDF page index 28) specifies 256KB of DRAM in four 64KB maps. This is the same-chip 256KB ISA adapter implementation, explicitly distinct from the catalog integrated implementation; not XGA or MCGA.
